topic: Visualizing Complex Equations: Winding Numbers and Domain Coloring
target_audience: University students (STEM majors or computer graphics enthusiasts)

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Complex Plane
lecture_lines: Complex plane maps inputs z to outputs w.
Grid squares warp into complex shapes.
Functions transform space like a rubber sheet.
Mapping shows how space bends and flows.
Visualizing functions reveals their hidden nature.

sections.title: Domain Coloring: Painting the Function
lecture_lines: Colors represent phase of complex numbers.
Brightness indicates the magnitude at points.
animations: Create a grid of points spanning a square.
Color each point based on its phase angle.

sections.title: Winding Numbers: Counting the Loops
lecture_lines: Winding number counts loops around points.
Ant walking around trees defines paths.
animations: Draw a closed curve on the complex plane.
Mark a point (pole) inside the curve.
Count how many times f(z) winds around origin.

sections.title: Numerical Algorithms: Finding the Roots
lecture_lines: Integrate winding numbers over small regions.
Computers locate roots without algebraic solving.
